data: Zaradi slabih poslovnih rezultatov se majhen hotel prodaja mednarodnemu kupcu. Zaposleni ne želijo izgubiti službe, zato vzamejo stvari v svoje roke in poskušajo sabotirati prodajo hotela. (Alexander is 30 years old and has never been in love - or has never been in love. He then sees in Paula, a theater actress, the possibility of sharing a future with someone.)
Zaradi slabih poslovnih rezultatov se majhen hotel prodaja mednarodnemu kupcu. Zaposleni ne želijo izgubiti službe, zato vzamejo stvari v svoje roke in poskušajo sabotirati prodajo hotela.
Alexander is 30 years old and has never been in love - or has never been in love. He then sees in Paula, a theater actress, the possibility of sharing a future with someone.
